item.title: Lawmakers hired researchers to figure out how to fix West Virginia’s schools. Here’s what they recommended.

item.title: Relatives who take care of foster kids could get financial support from the state more quickly under new proposal
item.description: Almost two out of three kids in state custody are cared for by a grandparent or relative. Republican lawmakers want to help ensure these kinship families get paid as much as foster families. The state says it would cost $3.9 million each year.
